definitions.explanation: A decorative design, illustration, or pattern on a surface. Used for designs on fabric, stamps, currency, cards, pottery, and similar items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{図柄|ずがら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The design for the new stamps was announced.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{図柄|ずがら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: This kimono has a beautiful pattern.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}しい⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{図柄|ずがら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歴史上|れきしじょう}→歴史上：24044_rekishijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The designs on the new banknotes depict historical figures.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (drawing, diagram) + ⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧ (pattern, design). Refers specifically to a pictorial or decorative design printed or drawn on a surface.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{図柄|ずがら}: stamp design
- ⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{図柄|ずがら}: banknote design
- ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{図柄|ずがら}: kimono pattern
- {図柄|ずがら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a design
- {図柄|ずがら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧: with a design on it

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧: pattern — broader, includes abstract repeating patterns
- ⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧: pattern — the base element, often for fabric patterns
- ⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧: design — loanword, broader and more modern
- ⟦{絵柄|えがら}→絵柄：13866_egara⟧: picture/illustration design — very similar, slightly more emphasis on pictorial art
